Propanoic acid is a carboxylic acid. It has similar chemical properties to ethanoic acid.
Which statements are correct?
1
Aqueous propanoic acid is a weaker acid than dilute hydrochloric acid.
2
Propanoic acid partially ionises in aqueous solution.
3
Propanoic acid reacts with ethanol to form propyl ethanoate.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
